title: Block loop output
statement: Given an output function on finite Boolean lists and an encoded state $s$, return the empty list if the first component of the decoded outer pair is empty. Otherwise, return the output function applied to $s$ if the first component of the decoded inner pair is empty; in all other cases return the empty list.
hypotheses_covered: The output function maps finite Boolean lists to finite Boolean lists
